# Xgenious — Custom Software Development Company

> Xgenious builds custom SaaS, web apps, mobile apps, and AI agents for mid-market teams. Fixed-price contracts. UK · US · UAE · BD.

## Services

- [Custom SaaS Development](https://xgenious.com/custom-saas-development-company): End-to-end SaaS products from MVP to scale
- [Web App Development](https://xgenious.com/web-app-development-company): B2B portals, dashboards, enterprise platforms
- [Mobile App Development](https://xgenious.com/mobile-app-development): iOS, Android, cross-platform
- [AI Agent Development](https://xgenious.com/ai-agent-development-services): Custom AI agents and workflow automation
- [MVP Development](https://xgenious.com/saas-mvp-development): Working product in 6–8 weeks

## Free Open Source Software

Xgenious publishes free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted software anyone can download, fork, and deploy.

### Genius School Management
Free school ERP system. Laravel 11 + React 18. 19 modules: student admissions, attendance, fees, exams, payroll, library, transport, hostel, inventory. Multi-school support. MIT licensed.
- [Genius School Management landing page](https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-school-management)
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 11, React 18, Inertia.js, MySQL/PostgreSQL
- Target users: Schools, colleges, NGOs, software agencies

### Genius CRM
Free self-hosted CRM. Laravel 12 + React 19. 12 modules: contacts, leads, deal pipeline (Kanban), tasks, company profiles, RBAC, REST API, 2FA, Docker.
- [Genius CRM landing page](https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-crm)
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 12, React 19, Inertia.js, MySQL
- Target users: Solo founders, small sales teams, developers, agencies

### Genius HRM
Free open-source HR management system. Laravel 13 + React 18. 13 modules: employees, payroll, attendance, leave, recruitment (ATS), performance management. 6 roles, 55 permissions.
- [Genius HRM landing page](https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-hrm)
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 13, React 18, Inertia.js, MySQL, shadcn/ui
- Target users: SMEs, HR teams, developers, agencies

### Zaika — Single Vendor eCommerce Laravel Platform
Self-hosted single-vendor eCommerce CMS and shopping platform built on Laravel. Single vendor eCommerce means one seller owns the store, the catalog, the checkout, and 100% of every sale — unlike a multi-vendor marketplace that hosts many sellers and splits commission. Zaika ships with a no-code drag & drop page builder (30+ widgets), grid/list shop layouts, 15+ payment gateways, and advanced inventory, product variants, shipping, tax, coupon, and time-boxed campaign systems. One-time purchase, full PHP/Laravel source code, no monthly fees, zero platform commission. Responsive web platform; a Zaika Flutter mobile app (Android & iOS) is included from the Everything Bundle and the Exclusive License. For a multi-vendor marketplace instead, see SafeCart.

Optional add-ons: professional installation $99, web + mobile app installation $399, support renewal $39
